payload.summary: Prefer the haversine formula over a flat-plane approximation for coordinate distance; haversine is ~104 ns/call (effectively free) while flat-plane adds up to ~55 m error at city scale.
payload.root_cause: Flat-plane approximation trades ~6% speed for up to ~55.4 m max / 21.0 m mean error at city scale (200k random pairs in a Berlin-sized box).
payload.action: Use haversineMeters(a, b) (vector-playground/src/haversine.mjs; mirrored in vector-common coords) for distance; only substitute flat-plane if a profiler proves a distance hotspot.
payload.verification: vector-playground/experiments/haversine-bench/RESULTS.md (104.4 ns/call haversine vs 97.9 ns/call flat-plane, 55.4 m max error); guarded by vector-playground/test/haversine.test.js (Berlin->Paris ~878 km, 1deg lat ~111 km, symmetry, identity).

payload.title: Privacy gate � learn from aggregates over road segments, never from individual traces (K=5, 72h TTL)

payload.definition: Learn from aggregates over road segments; never from individual traces. Raw GPS lives in a 72h quarantine and is never what persists; what persists is per-segment evidence past a k-anonymity floor (adr-0065).

payload.name: learned-fact
payload.description: Schema for facts produced by vector-learning aggregation. Emitted only when k-anonymity floor (K=5) is met. Never contains identity, raw coordinates, or sub-hour precision timestamps.

fields.sample_span_h: float — wall-clock span of contributing observations
fields.evidence_count: int — evidence units behind this fact
fields.decay: float — confidence decay factor (0.95 per week, applied at query time)
fields.contradiction: boolean — true if contradicts higher-confidence fact
fields.provenance: object { batch_id, stage: "learning", produced_at, watermark_id } — never contains identity/pseudonym/device/IP
fields.version: int — monotonically increasing version per fact_id for conflict resolution

constraints: No raw coordinate field permitted beyond centroid
No timestamp finer than time-band bucket (band only, see adr-0067)
No device ID, IP address, or user identifier permitted

payload.name: learning-svc
payload.purpose: Resumable, idempotent aggregation batch: quarantine store -> map-match -> k-anonymous evidence -> learned facts
